## Summary

Describe the change, its rationale and the related issue when applicable.

## Behavior and compatibility

State whether API values, ownership, bindings, profile pins, scope, or teardown
behavior changes. Explain migration/rollback implications when applicable.

## Verification

List the commands actually run and their results. Distinguish local API-server
tests, installations, and native-provider/workload evidence.

- [ ] Applicable `make verify` and `make verify-hygiene` checks passed.
- [ ] Generated outputs are included and were checked without repairing them first.
- [ ] Tests cover relevant failure/recovery cases; documentation reflects actual behavior.
- [ ] Commits carry author-matching DCO sign-offs and provenance has been reviewed.
- [ ] Content is approved public: no C1+ information, unapproved personal data, credentials or real production configuration.

Use the private reporting route in `SECURITY.md` for vulnerabilities.
